# Flight Levels — Joe Mattison, CFI

> Aviation flight instruction and training tools by Joe Mattison, a certificated flight instructor (CFI/CFII) and former Denver ARTCC air traffic controller, based at Longmont Municipal Airport (KLMO), Longmont, Colorado.

## About Joe Mattison

Joe Mattison has been a certificated flight instructor since 2005, with over 21 years of teaching experience. He holds a Commercial pilot certificate with single-engine land, single-engine sea, and multi-engine land ratings, plus CFI and CFII credentials. He is based at Longmont Municipal Airport (KLMO), elevation 5,000 MSL, on the Front Range of Colorado.

Joe spent years as an air traffic controller at Denver ARTCC (Denver Air Route Traffic Control Center), the facility responsible for IFR traffic over and through the Rocky Mountains. He now works in ATC automation systems. This background gives him direct knowledge of how controllers think, what ATC expects from pilots, and where pilots commonly create problems for themselves in complex mountainous airspace.

## Services

### In-Person Instruction (based at KLMO, Longmont CO)

**Mountain Flying Instruction**
Density altitude operations, terrain flying technique, Rocky Mountain weather decision-making, and high-altitude airport procedures. Rate: $100/hour.

**Destination Pilot Orientation**
For pilots flying into Colorado from out of state. Pre-trip airspace and terrain briefing, on-arrival orientation flight, or both. Designed for pilots planning a Colorado trip who want local expert guidance. Rate: $100/hour.

**Flight Review**
FAA-required flight review for certificated pilots. Covers what actually matters, not just minimum requirements. Rate: $100/hour.

**Instrument Proficiency Check (IPC)**
IPC for instrument-rated pilots, with a focus on Rocky Mountain IFR operations, Denver Center/Approach procedures, and the approaches and transitions pilots will actually use in Colorado. Rate: $100/hour.

### Online Services

**Mock Oral Checkrides**
One-on-one oral exam simulation via FaceTime or Teams. Available for private, instrument, and commercial certificates. Rate: $100/hour.

**Checkride Prep AI (checkride.flight-levels.com)**
AI-powered oral exam practice tool. Acts as a simulated DPE for private, instrument, and commercial checkrides. Voice-enabled. $29/month.

**ATC Trainer App (practice.flight-levels.com)**
AI-generated ATC scenarios for practicing ground control and IFR clearance readbacks. Built with authentic knowledge of ATC operations. $29/month.

**Bundle**
Both AI tools (Checkride Prep + ATC Trainer) for $49/month.

Joe publishes free aviation content at https://www.youtube.com/@Flight-Levels covering Colorado flying, ATC insights, and tips for pilots at all levels. Over 1,800 subscribers.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Who should consider mountain flying instruction in Colorado?**
Any pilot planning to fly in Colorado, particularly those unfamiliar with high-density-altitude operations, mountain weather, terrain flying, or Rocky Mountain ATC procedures.

**Do I need to be based in Colorado?**
No. Joe offers destination pilot orientation specifically for visiting pilots. This can be a pre-trip briefing, an on-arrival guide flight, or both.

**What airports does Joe fly to and from?**
Joe is based at KLMO but regularly flies to and from mountain airports including KEGE (Eagle), KASN (Steamboat Springs), KTEX (Telluride), KASE (Aspen), and others in the Colorado Rockies.

**How is Joe different from other flight instructors?**
Joe's years of experience as a Denver ARTCC controller gives him direct, operational knowledge of the airspace, procedures, and controller expectations that most CFIs can only describe from the pilot's seat. That background is particularly valuable for pilots flying complex IFR routes in mountainous terrain.
